opening_line: Saw the Animal Medical Center work, a site and a mobile app for a full-service vet hospital. I've designed a few vet sites myself.
Saw the Consolidated Water project, pulling a global water infrastructure brand from several domains into one site.
Saw the Khoury Mortgages project, a full rebrand and a new site delivered in one week. I've designed a few finance and real estate sites myself.
Saw the SLON Laser site, showing heavy industrial capability while still feeling like a modern service is a tricky balance.
Saw the Village Inn makeover, giving a budget hotel in the Concordia neighborhood a fresh image to match the remodel.
Saw the concept work in your studio, reorganizing The White House site around clarity and trust is a bold exercise.
Saw the Yumtein project, the build your own box option and the subscription-first setup are smart moves for a food brand.
Saw the Langham & Sons Roofing site in your portfolio. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Saw the Southside Pet Hospital site in your portfolio. I've designed a few vet sites myself.
Saw the Marsh Pirate site, a marina, taproom and outfitter all in one is a fun mix to design for.
Saw the annual reports for Women Building Futures and the Alberta School Boards Association, keeping those on schedule with content arriving late is no joke.
